name: Face Shape Haircut AI
summary: Measures your face shape for free, then unlocks haircuts on your photo and a barber card in one-time Basic, Plus or Pro purchases.
description: Face Shape Haircut AI measures face shape from a selfie (the face-shape step is free) and shows suggested haircuts on your photo, each with a one-page barber card. A 7-day money-back policy is stated, checkout is email-only, and the results page is kept for a year.

pricing.details: Face-shape report free. Pay once, no subscription: Basic 9 € (6 haircuts); Plus 18 € (12 haircuts, 5 named-cut tries); Pro 27 € (12 haircuts, 15 named-cut tries, plus color, beard or bangs). 7-day money-back.
